mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO eo_stock_ledger (id, product_id, biz_id, change_type, delta, stock_after) VALUES (#{id}, #{productId}, #{bizId}, #{changeType}, #{delta}, #{stockAfter})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.stock AS actual_stock, l.stock_after AS ledger_stock FROM eo_product p JOIN eo_stock_ledger l ON l.id = ( SELECT l2.id FROM eo_stock_ledger l2 WHERE l2.product_id = p.id AND l2.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY l2.create_time DESC, l2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.del_flag = 0 AND p.stock <> l.stock_after LIMIT #{limit}
